query: What is the process to file a complaint against a Block Development Officer (BDO)?
reference_answer:
Complaint against Block Development Officer (BDO):
To file a complaint against a BDO, contact the District Collector's office or the local Tahsildar office. You can also submit a written complaint to the Revenue Divisional Officer (RDO) or the District Revenue Officer (DRO).
answer: To file a complaint against a Block Development Officer (BDO), contact the local government office or district office where the BDO works. Follow their procedures for submitting complaints. [Document 1]
